result.topic_en: Calculations for a particular solution of a linear second-order PDE (heat/telegraph-type equation $a^2 \partial^2 w/\partial x'^2 - \partial^2 w/\partial s^2 + \partial w/\partial s = 0$) using characteristic-like variables $p+q = x'/2a$, $p-q = s/2$, with trial solutions of the form $\cos(p+q)e^{p-q}$, power-series expansions and a determination of a boundary curve $x/at = \cot(x'/2a) + x'/a$.
